name: Sunlit Iwan
summary: A luminous sun rises from the threshold of a tall, open mosque drawn in tapered ink curves.
why: The sun shares the center x=54 with the inner and outer dome and physically joins the threshold at y=69. Both short minarets mirror each other and join the same foundation. The broad open interior gives the sunrise room to be part of the mark.
risk: The tall open dome is more abstract than a solid building. At the smallest size the sun becomes a luminous doorway.
sub1: The sun grows from the threshold
sub2: Mirrored towers and one central axis
reasonToChoose: You want a bright mosque with abundant negative space and a clear feeling of morning.
